description: Implementation of ManufacturerService interface for managing manufacturer entities, including CRUD operations, listing by store and categories, and description management, within a Java Spring application.

classes.name: ManufacturerServiceImpl
classes.description: A service class in Spring for managing Manufacturer entities, extending generic entity service, implementing manufacturer-specific operations, and integrating with DAO and search services.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a manufacturer after retrieving it by ID to ensure it exists.

methods.name: getCountManufAttachedProducts
methods.description: Returns the count of products attached to a specific manufacturer.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists manufacturers associated with a specific store, optionally filtered by language.

methods.name: listByProductsByCategoriesId
methods.description: Lists manufacturers associated with products in the given categories within a store.

methods.name: addManufacturerDescription
methods.description: Adds a description to a manufacturer and associates it, updating the entity.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new manufacturer or updates an existing one based on its ID.
